about: Design update for the ports-core deploy (PROFILE_VERSION 5, common/src/econ/designUpdate.ts): per account (username), what each saved ship becomes. A slot or design maps to a blueprint id under data/ships/blueprints: remakes/... for the hand-made player remakes (a folder the deploy ships and the server loads, but never lists as a library ship), a bare id with stock: true for a stock library ship (the current one replaces the old). 'wipe' means the account's ships are broken down and refunded and it gets a fresh starter; only its ships change. 'was' is the save each remake was made from (name and part count, from production on 2026-11-07): a save that no longer matches has changed since and is wiped, not swapped. Slots are 0-based hangar indices; designs are indices into the profile's designs list. Anything not listed here is wiped. The game applies this at login to any save below v5; scripts/db/designUpdate.ts applies it to every save at the deploy.
